183 likes, 12 comments - anahitadhondy on October 9, 2026: "The ONE COFFEE CAKE recipe you need ☕🍰 | #AnahitaCooks 👩‍🍳 

A soft, buttery coffee loaf infused with espresso and topped with a smooth coffee glaze. Perfectly balanced between rich coffee flavour and sweetness, this is the ideal bake to pair with your afternoon coffee!

INGREDIENTS
All-purpose flour – 180 g
Cornstarch – 30 g
Baking powder – 2 tsp
Salt – 1/2 tsp
Butter – 100 g, softened
Neutral oil – 2 tbsp
Granulated sugar – 150 g
Eggs – 3 large
Plain yogurt – 120 g
Vanilla extract – 2 tsp
Instant espresso powder or instant coffee – 2 tbsp
Hot water – 2 tbsp
Milk – 50 ml

For the Coffee Glaze
Powdered sugar – 200 g
Brewed espresso or strong coffee – 2–3 tsp

METHOD
1. Preheat the oven to 170°C. Grease and line a 9 × 5-inch loaf tin.
2. ⁠Dissolve the instant coffee in hot water and let it cool slightly.
3. ⁠In a bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and salt.
4. ⁠In another bowl, beat the butter, oil, and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
5. ⁠Mix in the vanilla, yogurt, cooled coffee mixture, and milk.
6. ⁠Gently fold in the dry ingredients until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
7. ⁠Pour the batter into the prepared loaf tin and bake for 50–60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the centre comes out with a few moist crumbs.
8. ⁠Allow the cake to cool completely.
9. ⁠For the glaze, whisk the powdered sugar with the brewed coffee until smooth. Drizzle over the cooled cake and let it set before slicing.

#coffeecake #espresso #espressoloaf #teacake".
